what: The M1 material classes (settlements/xanadu/STACK-PLAN.md section 5; GRAPHICS-TERRAIN-PROPOSAL.md M1; STAGE-5-REPORT.md section 4). A build's materials.json names one per family ("class"); Stage 8's tools/textures/pack.py reads this table through tools/textures/mclass.py to pack each family; core/materials/classes/10-mat-class.js checks the names (test-class.js). Today's pack.py ignores the field: nothing is re-packed before Stage 8 (the owner, 2026-11-22: data now, looks after).

rule.what: the stack's glazed rule (STAGE-5-REPORT.md section 4): a lit family whose specular is at least specularMin and whose roughness (the library record's, lifted by the family's roughLift as pack.py lifts the map) is under roughnessMax. A family classed glazed that the rule misses is glazed by name; a family the rule takes that is not classed glazed is listed too. Neither changes a look: each is a decision recorded, not a fault.

glazed.what: smooth, specular, often curved: glazed tile, mosaic, polished marble, gilt, lacquer. The one class whose normals the web packs at 8 bits (the owner, 2026-11-22: glazed families only), so curved highlights do not band

relief.what: masonry, rubble, paving, timber, thatch and the ground sets: the height carries the look. M3 planar POM where hero, M4 concave cavity

flat.what: no relief worth a height channel: plaster and washes, cloth, metals, painted pattern sheets, detail maps, mapOnly sheets. Gate 1 demands no height range (pack.py's "flat": true)

card.what: an alpha cut-out (a jali, a leaf card): RGBA colour and alpha, no normal or roughness map, and never a height in the alpha (Gate 1)
